name: 115.简

basedOn.note: User screenshots exposed a concrete search regression: results are returned, but tapping search-result folders produces an empty-link rule error; Test4 file-manager UX has not yet been explicitly device-approved.

features: replace the legacy 115Search page with a dedicated search module instead of leaving result URLs to the old rule
fix folder search results by routing the real folder ID into the enhanced 115FileManage page
make video search results play through the existing player.resolve contract and route other files to File Information
remove literal HTML markup from the keyword summary and use plain native text
add server-side search category filters for folder/video/image/audio/document/archive and sort cycling for name/time/size
support pagination with duplicate-page termination protection
prefer an existing filesSearch client method when present; otherwise capture the already-authenticated getFiles GET transport and safely retarget it to webapi /files/search
keep login, Cookie/m115, magnet/offline flow, player, recycle-bin operations, BatchOps and FileOps contracts unchanged
